$comment: Derived from the committed signed bundle known-answer/signed-examples/session-bundle/kat-keypair-001-bundle.json (kat-session-bundle-001): the same inner `session_bundle` body, its embedded participant TCT and its committed coordinator signature (kat-keypair-001), with `version` changed from `aitp/0.3` to `aitp/9.9` after signing. `aitp/9.9` is chosen because no release will assign it. The signature verifies over the original body and not over this one (both checked by scripts/verify-known-answer.mjs and scripts/recompute-known-answer-independent.py), so a verifier that checked the signature first would report BUNDLE_INVALID_SIGNATURE. A runner MUST NOT re-mint it. `input.coordinator_manifest` is the committed signed Manifest known-answer/signed-examples/manifest/kat-keypair-001-manifest.json, so nothing in the fixture needs minting; it is never consulted, because step 1 rejects before coordinator key resolution (step 5). The body has no unknown member, so the §5 member-set check passes. The schema's `version` const also rejects `aitp/9.9`, but the code comes from §5 step 1, not from a generic structural rejection (SESSION_BUNDLE_INVALID is only the aggregate fallback). Pins the code VERSIONING.md names as the bundle's unknown-version code.
description: Session Trust Bundle whose inner `session_bundle` body declares a `version` the receiver does not implement, changed after signing. RFC-AITP-0010 §5 step 1 (version check) runs before coordinator key resolution (step 5) and the bundle signature (step 6). Receivers that opt into RFC-AITP-0010 MUST reject with BUNDLE_VERSION_MISMATCH. Expected: BUNDLE_VERSION_MISMATCH, not BUNDLE_INVALID_SIGNATURE and not UNKNOWN_VERSION.

expected.rationale: `session_bundle.version` is `aitp/9.9`, not `aitp/0.3` or a later supported version. RFC-AITP-0010 §5 step 1 rejects it with BUNDLE_VERSION_MISMATCH before the bundle signature is checked at step 6, even though that signature also fails (it was made over the `aitp/0.3` body). The bundle is otherwise fresh (now 1711900100 < expires_at 1711903600), meets the §6 expiry invariant, and lists the receiver.
